Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
(sorry for the bad Pun)
There is a combat card for gargoyles or concordant vampires (SWOOP) stating
:

Requires a ready minion with Flight. Maneuver, only usable to go to close
range, and this vampire gets +1 strength on his initial strike this round. A
minion may play only 1 Swoop each round.

One player wanted to play that but we were already at close range. Is this
card only playable at long ? Is this card only playable during the maneuver
step ? or can it be played during the choose strikestep ?

Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:
"Reyda" <re...@noos.fr> wrote in news:a2730h$n1i$1...@hadron.noos.net:



If the maneuver is only usable to move to close range, you can only use it
when at long range. It's still a maneuver though, so you can only use it
during the range step, and you can't play it only for the +1 strength
part.

See also: 'Press, only usable to end combat'.

Flux
